Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by misreading the initial search results from the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer explicitly reported that "Roy White had 519 at-bats for the Yankees in 1977" (citing Baseball-Reference) but did *not* identify Roy White as the player with the most walks. However, the Planner incorrectly interpreted this partial data as identifying Roy White as the walks leader and used the 519 at-bats figure as his final answer. This led to the wrong conclusion and prevented the system from correctly identifying Willie Randolph (who had 64 walks, the actual leader, or potentially another player depending on the specific dataset, but certainly not the one with 519 ABs if Roy White was the one cited). The Planner failed to verify the "most walks" condition before accepting the at-bats figure, leading to an incorrect solution from the start.
